newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's S.Costa sells shopping centre.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's S.Costa sells shopping centre.

text.p: Portuguese construction company Sociedade de Construcoes Soares da Costa has sold its "Bom Sucesso" shopping centre for 12.5 billion escudos, the company said in a statement.

Soares da Costa said it had sold the Oporto shopping centre, including an office block, to a company called Tratado which it said was owned by a group of shareholders who also hold stakes in Soares da Costa. It did not elaborate.
Soares da Costa shares rose on the news. At 1025 GMT the shares were up 40 escudos at 1,800 on volume of 127,072.
